```{r}
# Linear Regression
linear_reg_data_generation <- function(
    n,
    n_test,
    p) {
  true_coefs <- rnorm(p)
  noise_sd <- runif(1, 5, 8)
  noise <- rnorm(n, 0, noise_sd)

  train_x <- matrix(rnorm(n * (p - 1)), ncol = (p - 1))
  train_y <- true_coefs[1] + train_x %*% true_coefs[-1] + noise
  train_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(train_x, train_y))

  test_x <- matrix(rnorm(n_test * (p - 1)), ncol = (p - 1))
  test_y <- true_coefs[1] + test_x %*% true_coefs[-1]
  test_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(test_x, test_y))

  names(train_data) <- names(test_data) <- c(paste0("X", 1:(p - 1)), "Y")

  return(list(
    true_sigma = noise_sd,
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data,
    true_coefs = true_coefs
  ))
}

linear_reg_run_simulation <- function(
    train_data,
    test_data,
    approaches,
    syn_size,
    true_coefs,
    true_sigma) {
  model_error_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    PE = numeric(length(approaches)),
    EE = numeric(length(approaches))
  )

  cat_init <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = Y ~ 1,
    family = gaussian,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size
  )

  cat_init_custom_variance <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = Y ~ 1,
    family = gaussian,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size,
    custom_variance = (true_sigma^2),
    gaussian_known_variance = TRUE
  )

  cat_init_known_variance <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = Y ~ 1,
    family = gaussian,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size,
    gaussian_known_variance = TRUE
  )

  model_list <- vector("list", length(approaches))
  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MLE") {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = Y ~ .,
          family = gaussian,
          data = train_data
        )
      )
    } else if (grepl("known", names(approaches)[app_i])) {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = Y ~ .,
          cat_init = cat_init_known_variance
        )
      )
    } else if (grepl("custom", names(approaches)[app_i])) {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = Y ~ .,
          cat_init = cat_init_custom_variance
        )
      )
    } else {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = Y ~ .,
          cat_init = cat_init
        )
      )
    }

    app_model <- do.call(
      approaches[[app_i]][[1]],
      model_input
    )

    model_list[[app_i]] <- app_model
    if (NA %in% coef(app_model)) {
      model_error_df[app_i, "PE"] <- model_error_df[app_i, "EE"] <- NA
    } else {
      model_error_df[app_i, "PE"] <- as.numeric(mean(
        (predict(
          app_model,
          newdata = test_data
        ) - test_data$Y)^2
      ))

      model_error_df[app_i, "EE"] <- as.numeric(sum(
        (coef(app_model) - true_coefs)^2
      ))
    }
  }

  return(model_error_df)
}

linear_reg_result_df <- function(
    all_error_list,
    simulation_times) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_error_list))

  apps <- all_error_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (tbls_i in seq_along(all_error_list)) {
    add_to_result_df <- data.frame(
      Approaches = apps,
      PE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      PE_SE = numeric(length(apps)),
      EE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      EE_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )

    tbls <- all_error_list[[tbls_i]]

    for (i in seq_along(apps)) {
      PE_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$PE[i])
      EE_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$EE[i])

      add_to_result_df$PE_MEAN[i] <- mean(
        PE_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      add_to_result_df$PE_SE[i] <- sd(
        PE_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / sqrt(simulation_times)

      add_to_result_df$EE_MEAN[i] <- mean(
        EE_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      add_to_result_df$EE_SE[i] <- sd(
        EE_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / sqrt(simulation_times)
    }

    result_df[[tbls_i]] <- add_to_result_df
  }
  return(result_df)
}

# Function to format the entire table for all approaches
linear_reg_latex_table <- function(result_df) {
  # Function to format a single row for LaTeX output
  format_row_multiple <- function(result_df, index) {
    pe_mean <- sapply(result_df, function(df) round(df$PE_MEAN[index], 3))
    pe_se <- sapply(result_df, function(df) round(df$PE_SE[index], 3))
    ee_mean <- sapply(result_df, function(df) round(df$EE_MEAN[index], 3))
    ee_se <- sapply(result_df, function(df) round(df$EE_SE[index], 3))

    # Function to format numbers into scientific notation

    format_sci <- function(x) {
      if (is.nan(x) | is.na(x)) {
        return("-")
      } else if (abs(x) >= 1e10 || abs(x) < 1e-3) {
        base <- formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3)
        base_parts <- strsplit(base, "e")[[1]]
        base_parts[2] <- sub("\\+", "", base_parts[2])
        return(paste0(
          "$",
          base_parts[1],
          " \\times 10^{",
          base_parts[2],
          "}$"
        ))
      } else {
        return(return(formatC(round(x, 3), format = "f", digits = 3)))
      }
    }

    # Apply the formatting function to each mean and standard error
    pe_means_formatted <- sapply(pe_mean, format_sci)
    pe_ses_formatted <- sapply(pe_se, format_sci)
    ee_means_formatted <- sapply(ee_mean, format_sci)
    ee_ses_formatted <- sapply(ee_se, format_sci)

    # Create one row for LaTeX combining values across dataframes for each approach
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{", result_df[[1]]$Approaches[index], "} & ",
      "\\makecell{", pe_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", pe_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
      "\\makecell{", ee_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", ee_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
      "\\makecell{", pe_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", pe_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
      "\\makecell{", ee_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", ee_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
      "\\makecell{", pe_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", pe_ses_formatted[3], ")}} & ",
      "\\makecell{", ee_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", ee_ses_formatted[3], ")}} \\\\ ",
      "\\addlinespace"
    )
  }

  n <- nrow(result_df[[1]]) # Assuming all dataframes have the same number of rows
  latex_rows <- sapply(1:n, function(i) format_row_multiple(result_df, i))
  return(latex_rows)
}

# Logistic Regression
logistic_reg_data_generation <- function(
    swim_data,
    n) {
  swim_train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(swim_data), n)

  train_data <- swim_data[swim_train_idx, ]
  test_data <- swim_data[-swim_train_idx, ]

  if (any(sapply(
    train_data,
    function(col) length(unique(col)) == 1
  ))) {
    return(logistic_reg_data_generation(swim_data, n))
  }

  return(list(
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data
  ))
}

logistic_reg_run_simulation <- function(
    train_data,
    test_data,
    approaches,
    syn_size) {
  model_error_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    PBD = numeric(length(approaches))
  )


  cat_init <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = empyr1 ~ 1,
    family = binomial,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size
  )

  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MLE") {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = empyr1 ~ .,
          family = binomial,
          data = train_data
        )
      )
    } else {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = empyr1 ~ .,
          cat_init = cat_init
        )
      )
    }

    app_model <- do.call(approaches[[app_i]][[1]], model_input)

    if (NA %in% coef(app_model)) {
      model_error_df[app_i, "PBD"] <- NA
    } else {
      model_error_df[app_i, "PBD"] <- as.numeric(get_discrepancy(
        "mean_logarithmic_error",
        Y = test_data$empyr1,
        est_Y = predict(
          app_model,
          newdata = test_data,
          type = "response"
        )
      ))
    }
  }
  return(model_error_df)
}

logistic_reg_result_df <- function(
    all_error_list,
    simulation_times) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_error_list))

  apps <- all_error_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (tbls_i in seq_along(all_error_list)) {

      PBD_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      PBD_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )
    tbls <- all_error_list[[tbls_i]]

    for (i in seq_along(apps)) {
      pbd_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$PBD[i])

      add_to_result_df$PBD_MEAN[i] <- mean(pbd_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      add_to_result_df$PBD_SE[i] <- sd(pbd_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(simulation_times)
    }
    result_df[[tbls_i]] <- add_to_result_df
  }

  return(result_df)
}

# COX
cox_data_genaration <- function(n,
                                p,
                                n_test,
                                lambda = 1,
                                censor_rate = 0.8) {
  true_coefs <- rnorm(p)

  x <- matrix(rnorm((n + n_test) * p), ncol = p)

  # Choose half of the cols to be binomial and gamma
  to_change_cols <- sample(1:p, as.integer(p / 2))

  binomial_cols <- to_change_cols[
    1:(length(to_change_cols) / 2)
  ]

  chi_square_cols <- to_change_cols[
    (length(to_change_cols) / 2 + 1):length(to_change_cols)
  ]


  for (col in binomial_cols) {
    x[, col] <- rbinom((n + n_test), 1, runif(1, 0.25, 0.75))
  }

  for (col in chi_square_cols) {
    x[, col] <- rgamma((n + n_test),
      shape = runif(1, 1, 5),
      rate = runif(1, 1, 5)
    )
  }

  # Calculate linear predictor eta
  eta <- x %*% true_coefs

  # Simulate event times from an exponential distribution
  event_time <- rexp((n + n_test), rate = (lambda * exp(eta)))

  # Simulate censoring times (uniformly distributed)
  censor_time <- runif((n + n_test),
    min = 0,
    max = quantile(
      event_time,
      censor_rate
    )
  )

  # observed time is the minimum of event or censoring time
  time <- pmin(event_time, censor_time)

  # event occurred if T <= C, otherwise censored
  status <- as.numeric(event_time <= censor_time)

  names(x) <- c(paste0("X", 1:p))

  train_data <- data.frame(
    time = time[1:n],
    status = status[1:n],
    x[1:n, ]
  )

  test_data <- data.frame(
    time = time[(n + 1):(n + n_test)],
    status = status[(n + 1):(n + n_test)],
    x[(n + 1):(n + n_test), ]
  )

  return(list(
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data,
    true_coefs = true_coefs
  ))
}

cox_run_simulation <- function(train_data,
                               test_data,
                               MPLE_0,
                               approaches,
                               syn_size,
                               true_coefs,
                               entry_points) {
  out_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    PD = numeric(length(approaches)),
    EE = numeric(length(approaches))
  )

  cat_init <- cat_cox_initialization(
    formula = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size,
    entry_points = entry_points
  )

  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MPLE") {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ .,
          data = train_data
        )
      )
    } else {
      c(
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          formula = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ .,
          cat_init = cat_init
        )
      )
    }
    app_model <- do.call(approaches[[app_i]][[1]], model_input)

    out_df[app_i, "PD"] <- MPLE_0 -
      get_cox_partial_likelihood(
        X = test_data[
          ,
          !(colnames(test_data) %in% c(
            "time", "status"
          ))
        ],
        time = test_data$time,
        status = test_data$status,
        coefs = coef(app_model),
        entry_points = entry_points
      )

    out_df[app_i, "EE"] <- as.numeric(sum(
      (coef(app_model) - true_coefs)^2
    ))
  }

  return(out_df)
}

cox_reg_result_df <- function(
    all_p_list,
    simulation_times) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_p_list))

  apps <- all_p_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (tbls_i in seq_along(all_p_list)) {
    add_to_result_df <- data.frame(
      Approaches = apps,
      PD_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      PD_SE = numeric(length(apps)),
      EE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      EE_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )
    tbls <- all_p_list[[tbls_i]]
    for (i in seq_along(apps)) {
      pd_values <- sapply(tbls, function(sim) sim$PD[i])
      ee_values <- sapply(tbls, function(sim) sim$EE[i])
      add_to_result_df$PD_MEAN[i] <- mean(pd_values, na.rm = TRUE)
      add_to_result_df$PD_SE[i] <- sd(pd_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(simulation_times)
      add_to_result_df$EE_MEAN[i] <- mean(ee_values, na.rm = TRUE)
      add_to_result_df$EE_SE[i] <- sd(ee_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(simulation_times)
    }
    result_df[[tbls_i]] <- add_to_result_df
  }
  return(result_df)
}
```

# Linear Regression

```{r}
n <- 50
n_test <- 100
p_list <- c(30, 50, 70)
simulation_times <- 3
tau_seq <- seq(0.5, 50, 0.5)
seed_start <- 0

all_p_error_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))

for (p_i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p <- p_list[p_i]

  cat("\n\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  approaches <- list(
    "MLE" = list(
      stats::glm,
      list()
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ ($\\tau = p/4$)" = list(
      cat_glm,
      list(tau = p / 4)
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Bootstrap)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode  \\\\ with custom $\\sigma^2$ \\\\ (Bootstrap)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Mallowian)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "mallowian_estimate",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode  \\\\ with custom $\\sigma^2$ \\\\ (Mallowian)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "mallowian_estimate",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "cross_validation",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ ($\\tau = p/4$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p / 4,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ with known $\\sigma$ \\\\ ($\\tau = p/4$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p / 4,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ with custom $\\sigma^2$ \\\\ ($\\tau = p/4$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p / 4,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ with known $\\sigma^2$ \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ with custom $\\sigma^2$ \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0
      )
    )
  )


  all_sim_error_list <- vector("list", simulation_times)

  for (simulation_times in 1:simulation_times) {
    cat("\n\n Simulation times:", simulation_times)

    set.seed(simulation_times + seed_start)

    data <- linear_reg_data_generation(
      n = n,
      n_test = n_test,
      p = p
    )

    true_sigma <- data$true_sigma
    train_data <- data$train_data
    test_data <- data$test_data
    true_coefs <- data$true_coefs

    all_sim_error_list[[simulation_times]] <- linear_reg_run_simulation(
      train_data = train_data,
      test_data = test_data,
      syn_size = p * 10,
      approaches = approaches,
      true_coefs = true_coefs,
      true_sigma = true_sigma
    )
  }
  all_p_error_list[[p_i]] <- all_sim_error_list
}
```

# Logistic Regression

```{r}
n_list <- c(52, 39, 26)
p <- 13
simulation_times <- 3
seed_start <- 0
tau_seq <- seq(0.5, 50, 0.5)

data("swim")
swim_data <- cbind(swim$x, swim$y)

all_n_error_list <- vector("list", length(n_list))

for (n_i in seq_along(n_list)) {
  n <- n_list[n_i]

  cat("\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  approaches <- list(
    "MLE" = list(
      stats::glm,
      list()
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_glm,
      list(tau = p)
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Bootstrap)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Steinian)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "steinian_estimate",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "cross_validation",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$: $\\tau \\geq 0$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        binomial_tau_lower = 0,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$: $\\tau \\geq 0.1$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        binomial_tau_lower = 0.1,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\theta$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        binomial_joint_theta = TRUE,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\theta$ \\& $\\alpha$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        binomial_joint_theta = TRUE,
        binomial_joint_alpha = TRUE,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Gibbs Sampling" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint_gibbs,
      list(
        refresh = FALSE
      )
    )
  )

  all_sim_error_list <- vector("list", simulation_times)

  for (sim_t in seq(1, simulation_times)) {
    cat("\n\n Simulation times:", sim_t)

    set.seed(sim_t + seed_start)

    data <- logistic_reg_data_generation(
      swim_data = swim_data,
      n = n
    )
    train_data <- data$train_data
    test_data <- data$test_data

    all_sim_error_list[[sim_t]] <- logistic_reg_run_simulation(
      train_data = train_data,
      test_data = test_data,
      syn_size = 10 * p,
      approaches = approaches
    )
  }
  all_n_error_list[[n_i]] <- all_sim_error_list
}
```

# Cox Regression

```{r}
n <- 100
n_test <- 200
p_list <- c(10, 30, 50)
cre_max_iter <- 50
center_rate <- 0.5
lambda <- 1
simulation_times <- 3
seed_start <- 0
tau_seq <- seq(0.1, 100.1, 0.5)

all_p_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))

for (p_i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p <- p_list[[p_i]]

  cat("\n\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  approaches <- list(
    "MPLE" = list(
      survival::coxph,
      list()
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: CRE \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_cox,
      list(
        method = "CRE",
        tau = p,
        max_iter = cre_max_iter
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: WME \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_cox,
      list(
        method = "WME",
        tau = p
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: CRE \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_cox_tune,
      list(
        method = "CRE",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: WME \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_cox_tune,
      list(
        method = "WME",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_cox_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p,
        refresh = 0
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$)" = list(
      cat_cox_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0
      )
    )
  )

  all_sim_list <- vector("list", simulation_times)

  for (sim_t in seq_len(simulation_times)) {
    cat("\n\n Simulation Times: ", sim_t)
    set.seed(seed_start + sim_t)

    data_list <- cox_data_genaration(
      n,
      p,
      n_test,
      lambda,
      center_rate
    )

    train_data <- data_list$train_data
    test_data <- data_list$test_data
    true_coefs <- data_list$true_coefs
    entry_points <- rep(0, n)

    MPLE_0 <- get_cox_partial_likelihood(
      X = test_data[
        ,
        !(colnames(test_data) %in% c(
          "time", "status"
        ))
      ],
      time = test_data$time,
      status = test_data$status,
      coefs = true_coefs,
      entry_points = entry_points
    )

    all_sim_list[[sim_t]] <- cox_run_simulation(
      train_data = train_data,
      test_data = test_data,
      syn_size = 10 * p,
      entry_points = entry_points,
      approaches = approaches,
      MPLE_0 = MPLE_0,
      true_coefs = true_coefs
    )
  }
  all_p_list[[p_i]] <- all_sim_list
}
```
